  1780	                    file_actions.append((os.POSIX_SPAWN_DUP2, fd, fd2))
  1781	            if file_actions:
  1782	                kwargs['file_actions'] = file_actions
  1783	
  1784	            self.pid = os.posix_spawn(executable, args, env, **kwargs)
  1785	            self._child_created = True
  1786	
  1787	            self._close_pipe_fds(p2cread, p2cwrite,
  1788	                                 c2pread, c2pwrite,
  1789	                                 errread, errwrite)
  1790	
  1791	        def _execute_child(self, args, executable, preexec_fn, close_fds,
  1792	                           pass_fds, cwd, env,
  1793	                           startupinfo, creationflags, shell,
  1794	                           p2cread, p2cwrite,
  1795	                           c2pread, c2pwrite,
  1796	                           errread, errwrite,
  1797	                           restore_signals,
  1798	                           gid, gids, uid, umask,
  1799	                           start_new_session, process_group):
  1800	            """Execute program (POSIX version)"""
  1801	
  1802	            if isinstance(args, (str, bytes)):
  1803	                args = [args]
  1804	            elif isinstance(args, os.PathLike):
  1805	                if shell:
  1806	                    raise TypeError('path-like args is not allowed when '
  1807	                                    'shell is true')
  1808	                args = [args]
  1809	            else:
  1810	                args = list(args)
  1811	
  1812	            if shell:
  1813	                # On Android the default shell is at '/system/bin/sh'.
  1814	                unix_shell = ('/system/bin/sh' if
  1815	                          hasattr(sys, 'getandroidapilevel') else '/bin/sh')
  1816	                args = [unix_shell, "-c"] + args
  1817	                if executable:
  1818	                    args[0] = executable
  1819	
  1820	            if executable is None:
  1821	                executable = args[0]
  1822	
  1823	            sys.audit("subprocess.Popen", executable, args, cwd, env)
  1824	
  1825	            if (_USE_POSIX_SPAWN
  1826	                    and os.path.dirname(executable)
  1827	                    and preexec_fn is None
  1828	                    and not close_fds
  1829	                    and not pass_fds
  1830	                    and cwd is None
  1831	                    and (p2cread == -1 or p2cread > 2)
  1832	                    and (c2pwrite == -1 or c2pwrite > 2)
  1833	                    and (errwrite == -1 or errwrite > 2)
  1834	                    and not start_new_session
  1835	                    and process_group == -1
  1836	                    and gid is None
  1837	                    and gids is None
  1838	                    and uid is None
  1839	                    and umask < 0):
  1840	                self._posix_spawn(args, executable, env, restore_signals,
  1841	                                  p2cread, p2cwrite,
  1842	                                  c2pread, c2pwrite,
  1843	                                  errread, errwrite)
  1844	                return
  1845	
  1846	            orig_executable = executable
  1847	
  1848	            # For transferring possible exec failure from child to parent.
  1849	            # Data format: "exception name:hex errno:description"
  1850	            # Pickle is not used; it is complex and involves memory allocation.
  1851	            errpipe_read, errpipe_write = os.pipe()
  1852	            # errpipe_write must not be in the standard io 0, 1, or 2 fd range.
  1853	            low_fds_to_close = []
  1854	            while errpipe_write < 3:
  1855	                low_fds_to_close.append(errpipe_write)
  1856	                errpipe_write = os.dup(errpipe_write)
  1857	            for low_fd in low_fds_to_close:
  1858	                os.close(low_fd)
  1859	            try:
  1860	                try:
  1861	                    # We must avoid complex work that could involve
  1862	                    # malloc or free in the child process to avoid
  1863	                    # potential deadlocks, thus we do all this here.
  1864	                    # and pass it to fork_exec()
  1865	
  1866	                    if env is not None:
  1867	                        env_list = []
  1868	                        for k, v in env.items():
  1869	                            k = os.fsencode(k)
  1870	                            if b'=' in k:
  1871	                                raise ValueError("illegal environment variable name")
  1872	                            env_list.append(k + b'=' + os.fsencode(v))
  1873	                    else:
  1874	                        env_list = None  # Use execv instead of execve.
  1875	                    executable = os.fsencode(executable)
  1876	                    if os.path.dirname(executable):
  1877	                        executable_list = (executable,)
  1878	                    else:
  1879	                        # This matches the behavior of os._execvpe().
  1880	                        executable_list = tuple(
  1881	                            os.path.join(os.fsencode(dir), executable)
  1882	                            for dir in os.get_exec_path(env))
  1883	                    fds_to_keep = set(pass_fds)
  1884	                    fds_to_keep.add(errpipe_write)
  1885	                    self.pid = _fork_exec(
  1886	                            args, executable_list,
  1887	                            close_fds, tuple(sorted(map(int, fds_to_keep))),
  1888	                            cwd, env_list,
  1889	                            p2cread, p2cwrite, c2pread, c2pwrite,
  1890	                            errread, errwrite,
  1891	                            errpipe_read, errpipe_write,
  1892	                            restore_signals, start_new_session,
  1893	                            process_group, gid, gids, uid, umask,
  1894	                            preexec_fn, _USE_VFORK)
  1895	                    self._child_created = True
  1896	                finally:
  1897	                    # be sure the FD is closed no matter what
  1898	                    os.close(errpipe_write)
  1899	
  1900	                self._close_pipe_fds(p2cread, p2cwrite,
  1901	                                     c2pread, c2pwrite,
  1902	                                     errread, errwrite)
  1903	
  1904	                # Wait for exec to fail or succeed; possibly raising an
  1905	                # exception (limited in size)
  1906	                errpipe_data = bytearray()
  1907	                while True:
  1908	                    part = os.read(errpipe_read, 50000)
  1909	                    errpipe_data += part
  1910	                    if not part or len(errpipe_data) > 50000:
  1911	                        break
  1912	            finally:
  1913	                # be sure the FD is closed no matter what
  1914	                os.close(errpipe_read)
  1915	
  1916	            if errpipe_data:
  1917	                try:
  1918	                    pid, sts = os.waitpid(self.pid, 0)
  1919	                    if pid == self.pid:
  1920	                        self._handle_exitstatus(sts)
  1921	                    else:
  1922	                        self.returncode = sys.maxsize
  1923	                except ChildProcessError:
  1924	                    pass
  1925	
  1926	                try:
  1927	                    exception_name, hex_errno, err_msg = (
  1928	                            errpipe_data.split(b':', 2))
  1929	                    # The encoding here should match the encoding
  1930	                    # written in by the subprocess implementations
  1931	                    # like _posixsubprocess
  1932	                    err_msg = err_msg.decode()
  1933	                except ValueError:
  1934	                    exception_name = b'SubprocessError'
  1935	                    hex_errno = b'0'
  1936	                    err_msg = 'Bad exception data from child: {!r}'.format(
  1937	                                  bytes(errpipe_data))
  1938	                child_exception_type = getattr(
  1939	                        builtins, exception_name.decode('ascii'),
  1940	                        SubprocessError)
  1941	                if issubclass(child_exception_type, OSError) and hex_errno:
  1942	                    errno_num = int(hex_errno, 16)
  1943	                    if err_msg == "noexec:chdir":
  1944	                        err_msg = ""
  1945	                        # The error must be from chdir(cwd).
  1946	                        err_filename = cwd
  1947	                    elif err_msg == "noexec":
  1948	                        err_msg = ""
  1949	                        err_filename = None
  1950	                    else:
  1951	                        err_filename = orig_executable
  1952	                    if errno_num != 0:
  1953	                        err_msg = os.strerror(errno_num)
  1954	                    if err_filename is not None:
  1955	                        raise child_exception_type(errno_num, err_msg, err_filename)
  1956	                    else:
  1957	                        raise child_exception_type(errno_num, err_msg)
  1958	                raise child_exception_type(err_msg)
  1959	
  1960	
  1961	        def _handle_exitstatus(self, sts,
  1962	                               _waitstatus_to_exitcode=_waitstatus_to_exitcode,
  1963	                               _WIFSTOPPED=_WIFSTOPPED,
  1964	                               _WSTOPSIG=_WSTOPSIG):
  1965	            """All callers to this function MUST hold self._waitpid_lock."""
  1966	            # This method is called (indirectly) by __del__, so it cannot
  1967	            # refer to anything outside of its local scope.
  1968	            if _WIFSTOPPED(sts):
  1969	                self.returncode = -_WSTOPSIG(sts)
  1970	            else:
  1971	                self.returncode = _waitstatus_to_exitcode(sts)
  1972	
  1973	        def _internal_poll(self, _deadstate=None, _waitpid=_waitpid,
  1974	                _WNOHANG=_WNOHANG, _ECHILD=errno.ECHILD):
  1975	            """Check if child process has terminated.  Returns returncode
  1976	            attribute.
  1977	
  1978	            This method is called by __del__, so it cannot reference anything
  1979	            outside of the local scope (nor can any methods it calls).
  1980	
  1981	            """
  1982	            if self.returncode is None:
  1983	                if not self._waitpid_lock.acquire(False):
  1984	                    # Something else is busy calling waitpid.  Don't allow two
  1985	                    # at once.  We know nothing yet.
  1986	                    return None
  1987	                try:
  1988	                    if self.returncode is not None:
  1989	                        return self.returncode  # Another thread waited.
  1990	                    pid, sts = _waitpid(self.pid, _WNOHANG)
  1991	                    if pid == self.pid:
  1992	                        self._handle_exitstatus(sts)
  1993	                except OSError as e:
  1994	                    if _deadstate is not None:
  1995	                        self.returncode = _deadstate
  1996	                    elif e.errno == _ECHILD:
  1997	                        # This happens if SIGCLD is set to be ignored or
  1998	                        # waiting for child processes has otherwise been
  1999	                        # disabled for our process.  This child is dead, we
  2000	                        # can't get the status.
  2001	                        # http://bugs.python.org/issue15756
  2002	                        self.returncode = 0
  2003	                finally:
  2004	                    self._waitpid_lock.release()
  2005	            return self.returncode
  2006	
  2007	
  2008	        def _try_wait(self, wait_flags):
  2009	            """All callers to this function MUST hold self._waitpid_lock."""
  2010	            try:
  2011	                (pid, sts) = os.waitpid(self.pid, wait_flags)
  2012	            except ChildProcessError:
  2013	                # This happens if SIGCLD is set to be ignored or waiting
  2014	                # for child processes has otherwise been disabled for our
  2015	                # process.  This child is dead, we can't get the status.
  2016	                pid = self.pid
  2017	                sts = 0
  2018	            return (pid, sts)
  2019	
  2020	
  2021	        def _wait(self, timeout):
  2022	            """Internal implementation of wait() on POSIX."""
  2023	            if self.returncode is not None:
  2024	                return self.returncode
  2025	
  2026	            if timeout is not None:
  2027	                endtime = _time() + timeout
  2028	                # Enter a busy loop if we have a timeout.  This busy loop was
  2029	                # cribbed from Lib/threading.py in Thread.wait() at r71065.
  2030	                delay = 0.0005 # 500 us -> initial delay of 1 ms
  2031	                while True:
  2032	                    if self._waitpid_lock.acquire(False):
  2033	                        try:
  2034	                            if self.returncode is not None:
  2035	                                break  # Another thread waited.
  2036	                            (pid, sts) = self._try_wait(os.WNOHANG)
  2037	                            assert pid == self.pid or pid == 0
  2038	                            if pid == self.pid:
  2039	                                self._handle_exitstatus(sts)
  2040	                                break
  2041	                        finally:
  2042	                            self._waitpid_lock.release()
  2043	                    remaining = self._remaining_time(endtime)
  2044	                    if remaining <= 0:
  2045	                        raise TimeoutExpired(self.args, timeout)
  2046	                    delay = min(delay * 2, remaining, .05)
  2047	                    time.sleep(delay)
  2048	            else:
  2049	                while self.returncode is None:
  2050	                    with self._waitpid_lock:
  2051	                        if self.returncode is not None:
  2052	                            break  # Another thread waited.
  2053	                        (pid, sts) = self._try_wait(0)
  2054	                        # Check the pid and loop as waitpid has been known to
  2055	                        # return 0 even without WNOHANG in odd situations.
  2056	                        # http://bugs.python.org/issue14396.
  2057	                        if pid == self.pid:
  2058	                            self._handle_exitstatus(sts)
  2059	            return self.returncode
  2060	
  2061	
  2062	        def _communicate(self, input, endtime, orig_timeout):
  2063	            if self.stdin and not self._communication_started:
  2064	                # Flush stdio buffer.  This might block, if the user has
  2065	                # been writing to .stdin in an uncontrolled fashion.
  2066	                try:
  2067	                    self.stdin.flush()
  2068	                except BrokenPipeError:
  2069	                    pass  # communicate() must ignore BrokenPipeError.
  2070	                if not input:
  2071	                    try:
  2072	                        self.stdin.close()
  2073	                    except BrokenPipeError:
  2074	                        pass  # communicate() must ignore BrokenPipeError.
  2075	
  2076	            stdout = None
  2077	            stderr = None
  2078	
  2079	            # Only create this mapping if we haven't already.
  2080	            if not self._communication_started:
  2081	                self._fileobj2output = {}
  2082	                if self.stdout:
  2083	                    self._fileobj2output[self.stdout] = []
  2084	                if self.stderr:
  2085	                    self._fileobj2output[self.stderr] = []
  2086	
  2087	            if self.stdout:
  2088	                stdout = self._fileobj2output[self.stdout]
  2089	            if self.stderr:
  2090	                stderr = self._fileobj2output[self.stderr]
  2091	
  2092	            self._save_input(input)
  2093	
  2094	            if self._input:
  2095	                input_view = memoryview(self._input)
  2096	
  2097	            with _PopenSelector() as selector:
  2098	                if self.stdin and input:
  2099	                    selector.register(self.stdin, selectors.EVENT_WRITE)
  2100	                if self.stdout and not self.stdout.closed:
  2101	                    selector.register(self.stdout, selectors.EVENT_READ)
  2102	                if self.stderr and not self.stderr.closed:
  2103	                    selector.register(self.stderr, selectors.EVENT_READ)
  2104	
  2105	                while selector.get_map():
  2106	                    timeout = self._remaining_time(endtime)
  2107	                    if timeout is not None and timeout < 0:
  2108	                        self._check_timeout(endtime, orig_timeout,
  2109	                                            stdout, stderr,
  2110	                                            skip_check_and_raise=True)
  2111	                        raise RuntimeError(  # Impossible :)
  2112	                            '_check_timeout(..., skip_check_and_raise=True) '
  2113	                            'failed to raise TimeoutExpired.')
  2114	
  2115	                    ready = selector.select(timeout)
  2116	                    self._check_timeout(endtime, orig_timeout, stdout, stderr)
  2117	
  2118	                    # XXX Rewrite these to use non-blocking I/O on the file
  2119	                    # objects; they are no longer using C stdio!
  2120	
  2121	                    for key, events in ready:
  2122	                        if key.fileobj is self.stdin:
  2123	                            chunk = input_view[self._input_offset :
  2124	                                               self._input_offset + _PIPE_BUF]
  2125	                            try:
  2126	                                self._input_offset += os.write(key.fd, chunk)
  2127	                            except BrokenPipeError:
  2128	                                selector.unregister(key.fileobj)
  2129	                                key.fileobj.close()
  2130	                            else:
  2131	                                if self._input_offset >= len(self._input):
  2132	                                    selector.unregister(key.fileobj)
  2133	                                    key.fileobj.close()
  2134	                        elif key.fileobj in (self.stdout, self.stderr):
  2135	                            data = os.read(key.fd, 32768)
  2136	                            if not data:
  2137	                                selector.unregister(key.fileobj)
  2138	                                key.fileobj.close()
  2139	                            self._fileobj2output[key.fileobj].append(data)
  2140	
  2141	            self.wait(timeout=self._remaining_time(endtime))
  2142	
  2143	            # All data exchanged.  Translate lists into strings.
  2144	            if stdout is not None:
  2145	                stdout = b''.join(stdout)
  2146	            if stderr is not None:
  2147	                stderr = b''.join(stderr)
  2148	
  2149	            # Translate newlines, if requested.
  2150	            # This also turns bytes into strings.
  2151	            if self.text_mode:
  2152	                if stdout is not None:
  2153	                    stdout = self._translate_newlines(stdout,
  2154	                                                      self.stdout.encoding,
  2155	                                                      self.stdout.errors)
  2156	                if stderr is not None:
  2157	                    stderr = self._translate_newlines(stderr,
  2158	                                                      self.stderr.encoding,
  2159	                                                      self.stderr.errors)
  2160	
  2161	            return (stdout, stderr)
  2162	
  2163	
  2164	        def _save_input(self, input):
  2165	            # This method is called from the _communicate_with_*() methods
  2166	            # so that if we time out while communicating, we can continue
  2167	            # sending input if we retry.
  2168	            if self.stdin and self._input is None:
  2169	                self._input_offset = 0
  2170	                self._input = input
  2171	                if input is not None and self.text_mode:
  2172	                    self._input = self._input.encode(self.stdin.encoding,
  2173	                                                     self.stdin.errors)
  2174	
  2175	
  2176	        def send_signal(self, sig):
  2177	            """Send a signal to the process."""
  2178	            # bpo-38630: Polling reduces the risk of sending a signal to the
  2179	            # wrong process if the process completed, the Popen.returncode
  2180	            # attribute is still None, and the pid has been reassigned
  2181	            # (recycled) to a new different process. This race condition can
  2182	            # happens in two cases.
  2183	            #
  2184	            # Case 1. Thread A calls Popen.poll(), thread B calls
  2185	            # Popen.send_signal(). In thread A, waitpid() succeed and returns
  2186	            # the exit status. Thread B calls kill() because poll() in thread A
  2187	            # did not set returncode yet. Calling poll() in thread B prevents
  2188	            # the race condition thanks to Popen._waitpid_lock.
  2189	            #
  2190	            # Case 2. waitpid(pid, 0) has been called directly, without
  2191	            # using Popen methods: returncode is still None is this case.
  2192	            # Calling Popen.poll() will set returncode to a default value,
  2193	            # since waitpid() fails with ProcessLookupError.
  2194	            self.poll()
  2195	            if self.returncode is not None:
  2196	                # Skip signalling a process that we know has already died.
  2197	                return
  2198	
  2199	            # The race condition can still happen if the race condition
  2200	            # described above happens between the returncode test
  2201	            # and the kill() call.
  2202	            try:
  2203	                os.kill(self.pid, sig)
  2204	            except ProcessLookupError:
  2205	                # Suppress the race condition error; bpo-40550.
  2206	                pass
  2207	
  2208	        def terminate(self):
